title: feat(spec)!: an authored connector entry refuses a top-level key it does not declare; the connector read withholds URL credential parts and a non-object auth
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — every connector entry `skills/**`, `content/docs/**`, `examples/**` and `packages/apps/**` author (each `defineConnector({…})` and `connectors: [{…}]` literal, scanned) already uses only declared entry keys, so nothing they teach changes; the new refusal carries its own prescription.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：作者编写的连接器条目（`connectors:` / `PUT /meta/connector/:name`）改为封闭结构，未声明的顶层键在 defineStack、os validate/compile、构建产物加载与保存时按键名拒绝（保存为 422）；连接器的元数据读取额外隐去 `providerConfig` 下 URL 的 userinfo 与凭据类 query 参数，以及非对象形态的 `auth` / `authentication`。
- 为什么改：QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)
- 风险与回滚：在连接器条目顶层多写了键的元数据会被拒（错误信息给出改法：凭据走 `auth.credentialRef`，provider 配置挪进 `providerConfig`）；插件 `registerConnector` 的运行时形状不变。读出的 URL 去掉凭据部分后原样保存，存储值保留、运行时照常使用。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts`（`DeclarativeConnectorEntryBaseSchema` 与 `connectorBaseShape`）、`packages/spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.ts`（`credentialPathsOf` 的非对象分支与 `credentialUrlRewritesOf`）、`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-authoring-lint.test.ts`（最后一个开放根关闭，下限改为 0）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/connector-meta-door-entry-and-url-hardening.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 9 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

**Write door.** An authored connector entry (`DeclarativeConnectorEntrySchema`) is closed. It refines a dedicated `strictObject` carrier, `DeclarativeConnectorEntryBaseSchema`, built from the same shape declaration as the open base (`connectorBaseShape()`, called once per carrier so each has its own field instances and the guidance census never pairs the open `Connector` def with the closed declaration). Every door that parses the entry refuses a top-level key the shape does not declare, by name, with a located `unrecognized_keys` issue: `defineStack({ connectors })`, `os validate` / `os compile`, the metadata plugin's artifact load at boot and reload, and `PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/:name`, where the answer is `422 INVALID_METADATA`. Two curated families ride the refusal: credential-shaped keys point at `auth.credentialRef`, and provider settings written at the top level (`baseUrl`, `spec`, `transport`, `headers`, …) point at `providerConfig`; a few near-miss spellings (`config`, `timeout`, `retry`) are aliases to the declared key. The ADR-0010 protection envelope stays declared, so a package-stamped entry still parses. The refusal is terminal, so a body with an undeclared key meets that one refusal and not the ADR-0097 refinements as well.

`ConnectorSchema`, the def a plugin hands to `registerConnector` and the shape `defineConnector()` parses, keeps its posture; a control pin says so.

**Read redaction.** The built-in `connector` redactor withholds two more positions:

- every URL at an object depth of `providerConfig` (a string starting with `scheme://`) is served without its userinfo and without its credential query parameters (the datasource names plus the HTTP conventions such as `api_key`, `access_token`, `token`, `key`, `sig`, and the `auth.paramName` an `api-key` instance names), the rest of the URL byte for byte. That covers `baseUrl`, `transport.url` and a URL `spec`. The query half goes through the same `redactUrlCredentialQueryParams` the datasource redactor uses, which now takes an optional name list (default and existing callers unchanged).
- an `auth` or `authentication` value that is not an object is withheld whole. Cleared forms (`null`, `''`) are served as written.

Each rewritten or withheld position is named in `redactedKeys`, so the protocol's carry-forward keeps the stored value on a save of the served form, and the runtime keeps reading the unredacted execution view.

**ADR-0087.** A D3 semantic entry, `connector-entry-undeclared-key-refused`, carries the prescription; there is no mechanical rewrite, because an undeclared key may be a provider setting whose home depends on the provider, or the only copy of a secret.

**Ledgers.** The strictness ledger's `integration/` row is re-classed from a flat `wire` to `mixed`, with the reason and the governing texts read before the close (ADR-0097, ADR-0143, ADR-0104, the type-schema suite's #2657 fence; none keeps the authored entry open). The authoring lint's last open root was `connectors`: its coverage floor moves to 0, asserted deliberately with the departed root confirmed rejected by the parse, and its two cross-collection fixtures move to a nested strip site (`connectors[].retryConfig`).

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-entry-undeclared-keys.test.ts` (new, 12 cases): the refusal for a scalar, a nested container and two keys on an instance and on a descriptor, pinned by `code`, `path` and `keys`, never echoing the value; both prescriptions; terminality; the stamped envelope; a retired key keeping its own prescription and the retired-default residue; the stack door; and the open `ConnectorSchema` as a control.
- `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.test.ts` (+15 cases): non-object `auth` / `authentication` withheld whole, cleared forms served; userinfo, a bare user-part token, case-insensitive query parameters, `transport.url`, a URL `spec`, a relative `spec` left alone, the instance's own `paramName`, untouched non-credential URLs, arrays and dot-spelled keys off the walk, and a withheld map not walked twice.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/connector-meta-door-entry-and-url-hardening.dogfood.test.ts` (new, 9 cases, showcase boot): WRITE refusals (`422 INVALID_METADATA`, the key named, nothing stored, `404` to a member); CONTROL (declared-keys-only instance saves, reaches `ready`, dispatches with the reference resolved); READ for a member and an administrator on the item, layered and list reads (both spellings), with the stored rows untouched; CARRY-FORWARD (a save of the served form keeps the stored URL whole, and dispatch sends it).
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-authoring-lint.test.ts`: the graduation above.

Ablation, one leg per fix, each with on-disk mutation proof and restore proof (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor count, blob change, blob back to HEAD, empty `git diff HEAD`), and for the dogfood legs a spec rebuild with `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` proving the marker reached `dist/` and was gone after the restore rebuild:

| Fix ablated | Spec unit (src) | Dogfood (dist) |
|---|---|---|
| entry back on the open base | 7 of 12 red (every refusal; controls green) | 4 of 9 red (3 WRITE; the list then serves the stored keys) |
| URL rewrites never applied | 5 of 32 red (every URL rewrite case) | 3 of 9 red (item and layered read, list, carry-forward) |
| non-object `auth` / `authentication` not withheld | 4 of 32 red (the four non-object cases) | 2 of 9 red (item and layered read, list) |

A first combined dist leg is not counted: its URL-rewrite marker was constant-folded by the bundler and the preflight could not find it in `dist/`, so that leg was redone per fix with a string-literal marker.

## Acceptance notes

- The `422` envelope locates an unknown top-level key at the entry root (`path: ''`) and names it in the message, as zod locates `unrecognized_keys` at the containing object on every closed type.
- An artifact `os build` wrote carries no undeclared key (it serializes the parsed stack), so only a hand-assembled artifact can meet the refusal at boot.
- `metadata-type-schemas.test.ts`'s two notes that described the connector as open are dated rather than deleted; the suite's fence (envelope only, no posture case) is unchanged.
